notes.title: 5.0.134 - Stability & Content Update
notes.notes:
5.0.133 - Stable Content Update

It has been a big last rework, but it was needed. A lot of quality of life changes, fixes, and some new quests & objects.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40004437/b5b254b43bedf4ab530026cdea10d9f95db8ec28.png

Now I can focus on new content coming ! Next update will be a small "Farming Update", adding new plants and hoes.

If you haven't seen my last devlog where I talk about this update and events, don't hesitate to watch here :
(English subtitles are available)
[previewyoutube=q4NXLYtgD9w;full][/previewyoutube]

Here is a shortened version of the log if you want to know main changes :
- added display of items in text
- items images are now displayed in some conversations and quests to be easier to know what item
- added island stats
- added stats menu
- reworked map, it's now readable and less ugly :D
- some random events are now visible on the map
- you can now move with the map opened
- reshaped UI style
- added stone furnitures set (chair, table, small table, shelf, wall shelf, lamp, stool)
- added bamboo shelves
- added new paintings
- added 3 puzzles
- added new quests given by Fulraste
- reworked Fulraste house
- added quick button for craft and menu next to the inventory bar
- added jug and full jug sprites
- added time limited quests
- added violet carpet
- removed possible unwanted UI above video
- added UI place to drop items to sell them when in a shop (easier to find for most players than right click)
- added Blaise Pascal
- added Pascaline
- added aligot
- added Blaise Pascal quest and Easter Egg
- updated positioning of lost items for random quests, now easier to find and limited to the city only
- added ability to lock NPCs doors for friends only or with keys
- it's now impossible to buy if the player don't have place in inventory
- the camera is now fully following the player
- removed ability to shake small plants (useless and can be tricky when trying to wiggle trees)
- constant UI is now fully hidden when communicating or inside a menu
- added special background for some places where you can see the map limits
- reworked and fixed random events
- random events are now correctly saveable
- crafts are now done one by one
- fixed game over
- fixed hour UI
- changed arrows and dice buttons, it's now images to avoid OS related rendering problems
- fixed random video crashes
- reworked managers - Game and World managers are now correctly splitted and more clean for incoming content
- reworked underground items system
- reworked save system - world are now separate files
- reworked world management, having more than 1 world in 1 game is now possible
- reworked tree trunks sprites 
- added a contrast filter on rendering, to have better colors
- increased size of the light for every objects emitting light
- fixed rendering of objects in displays
- it's now possible to put objects on tables
- fixed various UI glitches, removed useless horizontal scrolling bars appearing sometimes
- fixed craft and shops menus broken with some items
- fixed and added missing translations
- changed default keybindings
- video files and game files are now lighter
- fix objects still displayed by camera after being destroyed by a placed carpet / path
- Windows jre is now lighter
- fixed Linux libs
- fixed main menu on small screens
- optimized furniture preview rendering
- removed code duplications
- fix item dropped easily with miss clicks
- added ability to right click on inventory bar to interact
- clicking on UI will no longer trigger player's interaction / collection
- optimizations of camera
- updated Java to v22.0.1
- updated JavaFX to v21.0.3
- disabled controllers lib for security and compatibility issues, will be replaced later
- a lot of bug fixes & tweaks
- many QoL improvments
(+ made sprites for incoming updates)

notes.title: INCOMING UPDATE & EVENTS RESUME
notes.notes:
Hey !

First, I went to 2 different events in the last months :
    Origine Auvergne and Clermont Geek Convention 2024 !

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40004437/1f0614889a6aa57aea2667d5a702d04f7fd3678f.jpg

Next, big good news !
    KYMA won a prize from the department at the Clermont Geek Convention 2024 with its Easter Egg linked to the Puy-de-Dôme !
The money will let me be at 100% on the game for more time, and more content !

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40004437/0cae8fa5fe14e0de9a7845828844f4e728fe46cc.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40004437/124cce8b19ee81fe7618042c6c1792c2f3fb2fbf.jpg

Then, incoming content :
    New content incoming, with 5.0.X. I pushed a first version (5.0.36 at the moment) and I will push again more patches in the week. After that, I will continue to work on new content. Thanks everyone that I saw at Origine Auvergne and at the Clermont Geek Convention, for all your feedbacks and your support !


Don't hesitate to join the Discord to follow more of the work in progress here : https://discord.gg/HKwXE72b23

notes.title: 4.2.204 - Bug fix
notes.notes:
Hello ! I'm back after a week of vacations !

Little patch with a fix for little screens, the UI should not be broken on Steam Deck anymore.

I'm still on the next big update with story parts. I'm working on textures and design, the dev part is coming soon. As said this update should take some time because I'm working on new features for the dev side, to create new maps and reworking the existing shops in the future.

I will give you some news as soon as possible!
